content.text:
Built a complete playable browser game in `index.html`.

### Included
- Horror survival wave gameplay
- WASD movement
- Mouse aiming and shooting
- Baseball bat melee attack with Space/click
- Weapon command system:
  - `ak`
  - `desert eagle`
  - `shotgun`
  - `smg`
- Increasing zombie waves with different enemy types
- Surprise challenges:
  - Tsunami wall
  - Tiger chase
  - Pokémon-style creature rescue event
- Health, score, wave, and threat counters
- Wave transitions and weapon notifications
- Game-over and restart flow
- Responsive full-screen canvas presentation
- Dark horror-themed UI and visual effects

I also verified the embedded JavaScript syntax with Node. Browser screenshot verification was unavailable because Chromium is not installed in the environment.

content.text:
Updated the game into a 3D FPS-style survival experience.

### Added
- First-person perspective rendering with depth
- Warzone/Killing Floor-style movement
- WASD movement
- Shift sprinting
- Mouse look with pointer lock
- First-person weapon view
- Crosshair
- Enemy depth scaling and perspective
- Zombie waves approaching from all directions
- Weapon shooting and bat melee attacks
- Shield system starting at **100**
- Health system starting at **100**
- Shield absorbs damage before health
- Shield regeneration after avoiding damage
- Visible shield and health bars
- Health/shield numeric values
- Existing weapon command system retained
- Existing tsunami, tiger, and Pokémon surprise events retained
- Restart flow after death

The game remains self-contained in `index.html` with no dependencies.
